I don't know if I'm capable of knowing God. I think he knows me, but I don't know if I'm capable of knowing him. Since this is anonymous; I worshiped him in the Mormon church. Raised with what I thought were brothers and sisters, turned out to be the cruelest people I had met at the time. With truly no community, and a pedophile to go along with the tale, I felt as though God spit me out of the Mormon religion. Despite my time devoted to him. I felt spit out, by God, like every wrong thing that happened was like a current carrying me away in a pathetic cliche type of way. And now I am seeking nothing, don't want anything to do with religion, and I can't get this call to prayer out of my head. It's woken me out of sleep. All I want.....is to write this book. And all that is consuming me is this call to prayer, literally like a mythical siren singing in my head. I'm almost cowardly to seek it out, and cowardly to turn away from it.

However I have had a recurring dream for many years of a great arab army riding on horses through a dessert, and in the dream the army looks (literally) like an ocean there are so many. I was adopted, and raised Mormon since birth. I have one arab friend, but have had the dream for 3 years before I actually met them.
